emailSubject: FMB News | LPA Intensifies Into Tropical Depression 'Neneng' East of Luzon | August 18, 2026 | 7:00 PM PHT
headline: Tropical Depression Neneng Forms East of Northern Luzon, Enhancing Habagat
seoTitle: Tropical Depression Neneng Forms East of Luzon | FMB News
seoDescription: The approved FMB News evening brief reports that LPA 08F intensified into Tropical Depression Neneng east of Northern Luzon on August 18.
deck: The newly named cyclone was forecast to remain offshore while continuing to enhance monsoon rains and rough seas.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News evening package, citing PAGASA, reports that LPA 08F intensified into Tropical Depression Neneng at 2:00 PM on August 18.
The package says Neneng had maximum sustained winds of 45 km/h with gusts up to 55 km/h and was moving west-northwestward over the Philippine Sea.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The briefing says the cyclone was expected to remain offshore rather than make direct Philippine landfall, while its circulation continued to enhance the Southwest Monsoon.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: An offshore cyclone can still raise flood, landslide and marine risks by strengthening monsoon flow and sea conditions.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch PAGASA tropical cyclone bulletins for changes in intensity, track, rainfall outlook and gale warnings.
